items.title: File Einspruch against interest assessment
items.quote: Einspruch ist binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe möglich, schriftlich oder elektronisch beim Finanzamt Musterbergen; als Tag der Bekanntgabe eines einfachen Briefs gilt der vierte Tag nach Aufgabe zur Post.
items.computation: The letter is internally inconsistent about the date the notice was given to the post: the letterhead shows 'Datum 09.04.2027' (a Friday) while the body refers to 'diesem Bescheid vom 06.04.2027' (a Tuesday). Per the rule for contradictory dates, the earliest plausible date is used: Aufgabe zur Post = 06.04.2027 (Tuesday). Bekanntgabe = 4th day after that = 10.04.2027, which is a Saturday; under § 122 Abs. 2 Satz 4 AO the fictitious delivery day moves to the next business day, i.e. Monday 12.04.2027. The one-month Einspruchsfrist (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) begins the day after Bekanntgabe (§ 108 AO i.V.m. § 187 Abs. 1 BGB) and ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB): 12.05.2027 (Wednesday), which is not a Saturday, Sunday or NRW public holiday, so it stands as the deadline. (For comparison, using the letterhead date 09.04.2027 as Aufgabe zur Post instead would give Bekanntgabe on 13.04.2027 and a deadline of 13.05.2027 — one day later; the earlier date is used per the rule on contradictory letter dates.)

warnings: The letter's own date ('Datum 09.04.2027') does not match the date given for the underlying Bescheid within the text ('Bescheid vom 06.04.2027'); this affects the exact day the notification period (Bekanntgabe) starts, so the Einspruch deadline could fall on 12.05.2027 or 13.05.2027 depending on which date was actually the day of mailing — verify the actual postal dispatch date with the Finanzamt if in doubt.

The 46,00 € interest amount is stated as being paid out automatically with the refund ('Der Betrag wird mit der Erstattung ausgezahlt'); no action or specific payout date is given, so no separate payment item was created for it.
